entities.name: Kasla
entities.description: An angel of Zendikar sworn to protect the plane, who reforged her shattered halo into a scythe.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A goddess of Zendikar whose shepherd Kasla was.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Kasla defended Zendikar.

events.summary: Kasla shattered her halo in an act of heroism and reforged its pieces into a deadly scythe.
events.quote: After shattering her halo in an act of heroism

events.summary: Kasla fought in defense of Zendikar during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: She fought in defense of Zendikar during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: She acted as a shepherd of the goddess Emeria.
relations.quote: She acted as a shepherd of the goddess
